newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela to insist on new OPEC quota definition.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela to insist on new OPEC quota definition.

text.p: Venezuela will table a motion that OPEC oil quotas exclude domestic consumption at an Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) meeting next week, Energy and Mines Minister Erwin Arrieta said Monday.
"We are going to go with our permanent position that the quotas system be revised," Arrieta told reporters. OPEC members are to meet in Vienna, Austria on Nov 27.
"Internal consumption should be left out of the quota."
Arrieta made no comment on whether the meeting would see a production ceiling roll-over but said he expected no confrontations.
"In general there is a comfortable atmosphere and a climate of unity. There are no confrontations thanks to the market which has been very generous."

Venezuela, which is assigned an OPEC quota of 2.359 million barrels per day (bpd) is frequently cited as a blatant quota- buster. According to official figures obtained by Reuters Venezuela is exporting an average of 2.73 million bpd in 1996 and expects to raise that to 3.03 million bpd in 1997.

Arrieta said Venezuela would continue to withhold its official production figures, "because we do not want to see our official figures put at the same level or category as," those given by secondary sources.
Venezuela has not presented its official output figures to OPEC since March.
